text:
sana: Heads-up — Tokyo hub will reopen Mon May 4 for onsite work after the seismic retrofit. Please read the logistics below and RSVP on the calendar event if you plan to come in.

sana: TL;DR: limited capacity (50 people/day) for the first week, shuttle from Shinjuku (08:15 / 17:45), badge reactivation required, complimentary lunch Mon–Fri, and a short health & safety walkthrough on arrival. Full doc: https://redwood-internal/docs/tokyo-reopen

hiro: Awesome news. Can we get a heads-up on how capacity is enforced? Will it be first-come-first-served signups? @sana

sana: @hiro Yes — the booking form is first-come-first-served. We’ll open signups at 09:00 JST tomorrow. If demand exceeds supply we’ll run a waitlist and prioritize critical teams per the doc.

james (Facilities): Shuttle stops and pickup details here:
```
Shuttle (Shinjuku -> Redwood Tokyo)
08:15 depart JR Shinjuku South Exit (meet at bus stop B) — arrive 08:45
17:45 depart Redwood Tokyo — arrive Shinjuku 18:15
```
Please be on time; only two round trips/day for the first week.

yuko: Quick Q — are hotels covered for people traveling in from other cities? cc: @davina

davina (Travel): Short answer: no blanket hotel coverage. If you’re on-call or have a critical onsite task and need to travel, open a travel request and we’ll approve case-by-case. Expenses must use the Travel portal (policy link in the doc).

adele (Security): Badge reactivation steps: bring ID to the front desk, we’ll reactivate. No tailgating; building security will do random checks first week. Also please complete the safety orientation in the doc before coming.

hiro: I’ll coordinate a quick tour for new folks at 08:50 Mon. If anyone needs ergonomic equipment moved, DM me.

sana: Catering will provide boxed lunches for the first 5 days. If you have dietary restrictions add them to the signup form (there’s a field). Vegetarian/halal/gluten-free available.

calendar-bot: Event posted — "Tokyo Hub Reopen: Week 1 Onsite" Mon May 4 08:00–18:00. RSVP here: https://calendar.redwood/tokyo-reopen

takashi: Will there be a remote-friendly room for folks on hybrid schedule? I need a call room Monday afternoon.

james (Facilities): Yes — Room C is set up for hybrid meetings (camera + mics). Reserve via the usual room booking flow.

sana: If you can’t make it but want to visit later in May, we’ll open a recurring signup next week. Please respect capacity until the retrofit monitoring period ends.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Complete the Tokyo health & safety quiz before arrival — link in the doc. Failure to complete may delay badge activation. :white_check_mark:

yuko: Thanks team — RSVP sent. :thumbsup:

sana: Thanks all — reach out in DMs if you have special needs or access questions. Looking forward to seeing the Tokyo team back in the hub! :tada:
